purpose: Implement the four remaining inner domains as local control-store authorities with versions/source refs/withdrawal and deletion barriers/audience filtering, same ControlStore Worker IPC, schema4 publication manifest, and two-stage ReadView (metadata crop, re-authorization, body read only for eligible records).

baseline.head: 31af227
baseline.note: H1 + H5 + independent H1 verification committed/pushed; 1096 baseline tests

implementation.schema4: publication schema 4: memory+ability keep previous semantics; each of the four domains is available only when its instance initializes successfully; initialization failure publishes unavailable and commands fail explicitly; schema4 memory/ability updates no longer downgrade the manifest (pre-existing defect fixed)
implementation.relationship: complete account-tuple unique binding; same display name / same short id never merged; role/member/interaction assertions with sources; explicit merge/split CAS with history preserved; evidence/identity tombstones; audience filtering; no body copies
implementation.emotion: sourced observations with fixed policy version for decay/review, deterministic integer state, expression regulation expiry, non-human-psychology/unauthorized claims rejected, cross-audience isolation, source withdrawal downgrade
implementation.cognition: sourced claims/hypotheses/conflicts/review conclusions/revised action experience; facts separated from interpretations; self-asserted tool/world facts rejected by predicate; dependent conclusions drop on source withdrawal
implementation.personality: stable Profile versions; whitelisted diff; learning strategy fixed disabled; propose->review two-stage approval; CAS; source withdrawal fails closed; ordinary chat cannot change profile
implementation.readView: two-stage: capture metadata only (no body, no grant authority), validate capture per domain, then read bodies only for the captured intersection after audience/resource/source re-authorization; missing/incomplete body ports are explicit unavailable, never empty success
implementation.ipc: four domains registered in the same ControlStore worker; 9-11 typed commands per domain; view.readInnerBodies and captureLocal innerDomains
